subject_uz: Yo'l ta'mirlash uchun asfaltbeton mahsulotlarini 125, 158 va 185 km masofaga tashish xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Texnika bo'yicha ball: korxonaga tegishli mashina-mexanizmlar hujjatlari (texnik pasport, shartnoma) taqdim etiladi; eng ko'p 60 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Fleet scoring: documents for the company's machinery (technical passports, contracts) are submitted; up to 60 points.
requirements.quote: Корхонага тегишли бўлган машина-механизмлар хужжатлари (тех.паспорт шартнома ва шунга ўхшаш хужжатлар)

requirements.summary_uz: Xodimlar bo'yicha ma'lumotnoma my.mehnat.uz saytidan olinib taqdim etiladi (10 ball).
requirements.summary_en: A staff certificate from my.mehnat.uz must be provided (10 points).
requirements.quote: Корхонанинг ишчи ходимлари тўғрисида маълумотнома -10 ball (my.mehnat.uz saytidan malumotnoma taqdim qilinishini kerak)

requirements.summary_uz: Avval shunday ishlarni bajarganlik haqida ma'lumot (shartnoma, schet-faktura) taqdim etiladi (20 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Information on previously performed similar work (contracts, invoices) is provided (20 points).
requirements.quote: Avval ushbu turdagi ishlarni bajarganlik to'g'risida malumot (Shartnomalar, schet-fakturalar va shunga o'xshash malumotlar)

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlarni sifatli va o'z vaqtida bajarish uchun kafolat xati taqdim etiladi (10 ball).
requirements.summary_en: A guarantee letter for quality and timely performance is provided (10 points).
requirements.quote: Ишларни сифатли ва ўз вақтида бажарилиш учун кафолат хати

requirements.summary_uz: Aylanma mablag' yoki bank kafolati tanlov predmeti qiymatining kamida 20 foizi miqdorida bo'lishi kerak (taxminan 126 mln so'm).
requirements.summary_en: Working funds or a bank guarantee of at least 20 percent of the lot value are required (about 126 million UZS).
requirements.quote: танлов предмети кийматининг камида 20 фоизи мицдоридаги айланма

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi shu yo'nalishda ixtisoslashgan va kamida 2 yil tajribaga ega yuridik shaxs bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must be a legal entity specialised in this kind of work with at least 2 years of experience.

requirements.summary_uz: Soliq va yig'imlar bo'yicha muddati o'tgan qarzdorlik bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: No overdue tax or fee debt.
requirements.quote: Солиқлар ва йиғимларни тўлаш бўйича муддати ўтган қарздорликнинг мавжуд эмаслиги.

requirements.summary_uz: 158 km masofaga 450122 t/km tashish, 700 so'mdan: 315 085 400 so'm.
requirements.summary_en: Haulage over 158 km, 450,122 t-km at 700 UZS: 315,085,400 UZS.
requirements.quote: Асфальтобетон махсулотлариини 158 км га ташиб бериш хизмати 450122 тн/км х 700 сўм = 315 085 400 сўм ҚҚС билан.

requirements.summary_uz: Tanlovning yakuniy qiymati 630 100 800 so'm (QQS bilan); undan yuqori takliflar ko'rib chiqilmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: The ceiling price is 630,100,800 UZS including VAT; higher offers are not considered.
requirements.quote: Танлов охирги қиймати – 630 100 800 сўм ҚҚС билан. Ушбу қийматдан ортиқ қийматдаги таклифлар қабул қилинмайди ва кўриб чиқилмайди

flags.quote: 10 дан коп автотранспорт воситаси булса. Шундан уз балансида камида 50 фоиздан кам булмаслиги керак
flags.explanation_uz: Texnika sonidan 60 ball (jami 100 balldan, o'tish bali 50) bog'liq: 10 va undan ortiq avtotransport, shundan kamida yarmi o'z balansida bo'lishi kerak. Lotning umumiy hajmi taxminan 6 200 tonna (2 849 + 2 849 + 508 t), shuning uchun bunday katta park talab qilinishi hajmga nomutanosib ko'rinadi va ijaraga yoki shartnoma asosida texnika jalb qiladigan ishtirokchilar ball yo'qotishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: 60 of the 100 points (pass mark 50) depend on fleet size: 10 or more vehicles, at least half of them on the bidder's own balance. The lot totals about 6,200 tonnes (2,849 + 2,849 + 508 t), so a fleet this large looks out of proportion to the volume, and bidders who use leased or contracted vehicles may lose points.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ballar ishtirokchi shartnoma hajmini bajarishi uchun yetarli avtotransportga (o'z, ijaraga olingan yoki shartnoma asosida jalb qilingan) ega ekanligiga qarab berilsin; texnika soni lot hajmiga mutanosib belgilansin.
flags.rewrite_en: Award points according to whether the bidder has enough vehicles (owned, leased or contracted) to carry the lot volume, with vehicle counts set in proportion to that volume.

flags.type_label_en: Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Texnika sonidan 60 ball (jami 100 balldan, o'tish bali 50) bog'liq: 10 va undan ortiq avtotransport, shundan kamida yarmi o'z balansida bo'lishi kerak. Lotning umumiy hajmi taxminan 6 200 tonna (2 849 + 2 849 + 508 t), shuning uchun bunday katta park talab qilinishi hajmga nomutanosib ko'rinadi va ijaraga yoki shartnoma asosida texnika jalb qiladigan ishtirokchilar ball yo'qotishi mumkin.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 39 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 79% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 26%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 1 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): 60 of the 100 points (pass mark 50) depend on fleet size: 10 or more vehicles, at least half of them on the bidder's own balance. The lot totals about 6,200 tonnes (2,849 + 2,849 + 508 t), so a fleet this large looks out of proportion to the volume, and bidders who use leased or contracted vehicles may lose points.
In the customer's last 39 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 79% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 26%.
